caption: The drawing features three main objects arranged vertically within a rectangular border on a beige background. At the top center is a colored rendering of a rectangular brooch or medallion with rounded corners and a gold border, depicting a profile bust of a man facing left; the man has white hair, pale skin, and is wearing a pink or peach-colored jacket and a white cravat. A small gold pin is visible on the right side of the brooch. Below and to the left is a simple line drawing of a closed oval case, shown in profile with a small clasp and a decorative flourish beneath it. To the lower right, a similar brooch or medallion is drawn in outline, featuring the same profile bust of the man but without color, connected by a straight horizontal line to the closed case. The name "Marie Famulard" is written in small letters at the bottom right within the border, and the date "Dec. 16, 1936." is written even further to the lower right outside the border. The drawing uses soft pastel colors for the upper portrait and fine pencil lines for the other two diagrams.
title: Cameo Brooch
